```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(gt)
library(patchwork)
library(systemfonts) 
library(knitr)

base_colors <- c(
  "#0173B2", "#DE8F05", "#029E73", "#CC78BC",
  "#CA9161", "#949494", "#ECE133", "#56B4E9"
)

base_theme <- function(base_size = 10, base_family = "sans") {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size, base_family = base_family) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = base_size + 2, face = "bold", hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 5)),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = base_size, color = "gray30", hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 8)),
      axis.title = element_text(size = base_size, face = "bold", color = "black"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = base_size - 1, color = "black"),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      legend.title = element_text(size = base_size, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = base_size - 1),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.background = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      strip.text = element_text(size = base_size, face = "bold", color = "black")
    )
}

theme_set(base_theme())

scale_colour_discrete <- function(...) scale_colour_manual(values = base_colors, ...)
scale_fill_discrete <- function(...) scale_fill_manual(values = base_colors, ...)

dat_reg <- read_csv("data/updated_data.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |> 
  mutate(
    quartile = factor(quartile, levels = c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4")),
    OA = factor(OA, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Not OA", "OA")),
    fund = factor(fund, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Not funded", "Funded")),
    coop = factor(coop, levels = c("bilateral", "multilateral", "hyperauthored"), 
                  labels = c("Bilateral", "Multilateral", "Hyper-authored")),
    dominance = factor(dominance, levels = c("vn", "Balanced", "jp", "o"),
                       labels = c("VN-dominated", "Balanced", "JP-dominated", "Other")),
    fa = factor(fa, levels = c("vn", "jp", "o"), 
                labels = c("VN-led", "JP-led", "Other-led")),
    corr_type = factor(corr_type, levels = c("Vietnam", "Japan", "Both", "Other"))
  )

dat_core <- dat_reg |> filter(coop != "Hyper-authored")
```


```{r}
#| label: table1
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false

fmt_msd <- function(x) sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), sd(x, na.rm = TRUE))
fmt_npc <- function(x) sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", sum(x, na.rm = TRUE), 100 * mean(x, na.rm = TRUE))
fmt_fac <- function(x, l) sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", sum(x == l, na.rm = TRUE), 100 * mean(x == l, na.rm = TRUE))

total_n <- nrow(dat_reg)

tab_desc <- dat_reg |>
  group_by(coop) |>
  summarise(
    n = as.character(n()),
    Share = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * n() / total_n),
    `Mean (SD) Authors` = fmt_msd(n_authors),
    `Mean (SD) Countries` = fmt_msd(n_countries),
    `Mean (SD) Citations` = fmt_msd(cited),
    `Median Citations` = sprintf("%.3f", median(cited, na.rm = TRUE)),
    
    # Journal Metrics
    `Q1` = fmt_fac(quartile, "Q1"),
    `Q2` = fmt_fac(quartile, "Q2"),
    `Q3` = fmt_fac(quartile, "Q3"),
    `Q4` = fmt_fac(quartile, "Q4"),
    `Life Sciences` = fmt_npc(LS),
    `Social Sciences` = fmt_npc(SS),
    `Physical Sciences` = fmt_npc(PS),
    `Health Sciences` = fmt_npc(HS),
    
    # Collaboration (Redundant but requested)
    `Bilateral` = fmt_fac(coop, "Bilateral"),
    `Multilateral` = fmt_fac(coop, "Multilateral"),
    `Hyper-authored` = fmt_fac(coop, "Hyper-authored"),
    
    # Funding
    `Funded` = fmt_fac(fund, "Funded"),
    `Unfunded` = fmt_fac(fund, "Not funded"),
    `Bilateral Funding` = fmt_npc(bilateral_funding),
    `JP Funding` = fmt_npc(jp),
    `VN Funding` = fmt_npc(vi),
    `Other Funding` = fmt_npc(o),
    `Industry` = fmt_npc(ind),
    `Public` = fmt_npc(pub),
    `Academia` = fmt_npc(aca),
    `1 Sector` = fmt_fac(n_sectors, 1),
    `2 Sectors` = fmt_fac(n_sectors, 2),
    `3 Sectors` = fmt_fac(n_sectors, 3),
    
    # Authorship & Leadership
    `VN-led` = fmt_fac(fa, "VN-led"),
    `JP-led` = fmt_fac(fa, "JP-led"),
    `Other-led` = fmt_fac(fa, "Other-led"),
    `VN-dominated` = fmt_fac(dominance, "VN-dominated"),
    `JP-dominated` = fmt_fac(dominance, "JP-dominated"),
    `Balanced` = fmt_fac(dominance, "Balanced"),
    `Other Dominance` = fmt_fac(dominance, "Other"),
    
    `Mean (SD) Prop VN` = fmt_msd(prop_vn_authors),
    `Mean (SD) Prop JP` = fmt_msd(prop_jp_authors),
    `Mean (SD) Prop Other` = fmt_msd(prop_o_authors),
    
    `Mean (SD) N VN` = fmt_msd(n_vn_authors),
    `Mean (SD) N JP` = fmt_msd(n_jp_authors),
    `Mean (SD) N Other` = fmt_msd(n_o_authors),
    
    # Correspondence
    `Corr: Vietnam` = fmt_fac(corr_type, "Vietnam"),
    `Corr: Japan` = fmt_fac(corr_type, "Japan"),
    `Corr: Both` = fmt_fac(corr_type, "Both"),
    `Corr: Other` = fmt_fac(corr_type, "Other")
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(-coop, names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = coop, values_from = Value)

kable(tab_desc, digits = 3)
```
